idea-plugin.name: Kafka Topic Feedback-Loop Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Spring Kafka @KafkaListener method whose OWN transitive call graph (same class, or one injected collaborator, UNBOUNDED depth, cycle-protected -- not a fixed hop limit) reaches a .send(...) back to the SAME topic it consumes -- a real self-feeding/"poison pill" loop that can saturate an entire consumer group under load, documented as a real anti-pattern in Confluent's own guides on avoiding cyclic topic dependencies.

Never just "a producer and a consumer of the same topic exist somewhere in the project" -- that alone proves nothing; the real path back, resolved via a genuine whole-project call graph, is what this plugin confirms.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Spring Kafka's @KafkaListener (consumer side) and KafkaTemplate.send(...)/ KafkaProducer.send(new ProducerRecord<>(...)) (producer side), string-literal topic names only; a manual KafkaConsumer.subscribe(...) poll-loop consumer is out of scope (a different angle already covered by this catalog's own Kafka Premature Offset Commit Companion).

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Kafka listener transitively produces back to its own topic
